description.fun: A huge, flightless moth that crawls about on four legs, with messy smoke-white fuzz and spiky wings like flames. It looks a lot like Volcarona, and its body also borrows from Stegosaurus. Some think it was revived from prehistoric fossils, though no Volcarona fossils from that era have ever been found. Its Japanese name means 'wings slithering on the ground'.
description.guide: A Bug and Fighting-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Volcarona or a version of it from a parallel timeline. Its futuristic counterpart is Iron Moth.
description.tagline: A flightless, Volcarona-like moth that crawls on four legs
